faqs.a:
It is the intent of city council, and council finds it in fact necessary, to exercise
               to the fullest extent possible its authority to provide for the regulation and control
               of animals, including, but not limited to, licensing, prohibiting and punishing cruelty
               to animals, regulating the keeping of animals, prohibiting the running-at-large of
               animals, impoundment and disposition of impounded animals, and that such matters are
               in the interest of and are necessary in order to preserve and protect the public health,
               safety, and welfare.
(Code 1981, § 6-1; Ord. No. 3496, § 2, 12-14-1998)
